cohort: The study included all neonates who underwent neonatal hearing screening at a tertiary care center between June 2023 and May 2024.
finding: Out of 1625 neonates screened, 9 (0.55%) were confirmed to have hearing loss, which was significantly associated with high-risk factors including consanguinity, low birth weight, delayed birth cry, neonatal jaundice, NICU stay for more than 5 days, and premature delivery.
